actions.reason: In both BasicTokenizer.train and RegexTokenizer.train, the per-merge selection max(stats, key=stats.get) hashed and looked up every pair tuple again. It is replaced by: snapshot the values list (already built for the tie check), max over the plain ints, then find the first key holding that max via vals.index + islice over the dict. That is exactly the key max() returned (first maximum in dict iteration order), and the tie-break logic is unchanged and reuses the same values list. Equivalence harness identical; train_ir 0.9305.
